name: architecture
description: improve scans for module friction through three lenses: deepening (shallow modules, seam leaks, locality gaps), boundaries (recorded rules against manifest references) and conventions (unwritten conventions proposed as rules). improve-layout checks whether files that change together live together. enforce-boundaries sets up and proves a check per recorded boundary rule. The map-* skills draw landscape, dependency, C4, sequence, event, data and deployment views. record-decision writes an ADR.

medium.title: Preferred delivery medium
medium.description: Where the map-* views and the improve report go. auto (default): a local file; terminal: no page; file: a local file; artifact: a private Artifact (the improve report stays a local file); hosted is read as artifact. A team rendered-views file never publishes.

adr_template.title: ADR template
adr_template.description: Absolute or ~/ path to your own ADR template, used by record-decision when a repository has no ADR convention. Empty: the bundled template. A repository's team or personal architecture.yaml overrides it, and a repository's own ADR convention always wins.

adr_retirement.title: ADR retirement
adr_retirement.description: How record-decision retires a record a new decision reverses, after your yes. delete (default): remove the file; its number is never reused. supersede: mark it superseded. archive: move it to the ADR folder's archive folder. A repository's team or personal architecture.yaml overrides it.
